blocks.html: Where enclosed duct systems are connected to in-line fans not located outdoors, the fan shall be located in a room or enclosure having the same fire-resistance rating as the duct enclosure. Access shall be provided for servicing and cleaning of fan components. Such rooms or enclosures shall be ventilated in accordance with the fan manufacturer's instructions.
